svg.aria-label: ORIGINAL IA SUITE · HIC · USES PAID CLOUD MODELS. Sources are fetched and chunked with provenance into the wiki and its manifest. A question seeds manifest-first retrieval, which passes evidence to the model router, then to the post-processor that cleans the text and names sources, then to the PowerPoint exporter.
